scheme-label: Name of the openZIM classification system, i.e. the list of categories used to classify ZIM files (offline content packages, e.g. read with Kiwix).
category-for-children: Label of a category of ZIM files (offline content packages, e.g. read with Kiwix), shown to users browsing or filtering the content library. Keep it short. Examples of content in this category: Vikidia, African Storybook, Bookdash, children's school material.
category-encyclopedias-general-reference: Label of a category of ZIM files (offline content packages, e.g. read with Kiwix), shown to users browsing or filtering the content library. Keep it short. Examples of content in this category: Wikipedia (complete), Wikiquote, CIA World Factbook.

category-books-literature: Label of a category of ZIM files (offline content packages, e.g. read with Kiwix), shown to users browsing or filtering the content library. Keep it short. Examples of content in this category: Wikisource, Project Gutenberg Library, writing Q&A.
category-courses-textbooks: Label of a category of ZIM files (offline content packages, e.g. read with Kiwix), shown to users browsing or filtering the content library. Keep it short. This category is about the format of the content (textbooks, courses, lessons, exercises, exam preparation), at any level from primary school to university, not about a subject. Examples of content in this category: Wikibooks, Wikiversity, Khan Academy, university textbooks (LibreTexts), coding courses (FreeCodeCamp).
